_desc: Feature flags and section toggles — the ONLY place optional behavior is controlled. null = undecided (the build refuses to run until every flag is explicit).
_sources: Current state (final refinement, 2026-07-17): features oneko/visitorCounter/uiSounds/quotes ON, spotify OFF — all confirmed by Mit. Sections ON: blog (3 articles, bodies pending -> Coming Soon), projects, resume, gears, education, certifications. Sections OFF (no data provided yet): setup, terminal, books, movies, achievements, talks, skills (skills data still feeds SEO knowsAbout).

_fields.features.oneko: Pixel cat that chases the cursor and dodges hero elements.
_fields.features.spotify: Spotify 'Last played' strip in the hero. Needs Client ID/Secret/Refresh Token in .env.local.
_fields.features.commandKSearch: ⌘K / Ctrl+K full-text blog search dialog. Requires sections.blog = true.
_fields.features.rss: RSS feed at /blog/feed.xml. Requires sections.blog = true.
_fields.features.smoothScroll: Lenis smooth scrolling (reference has it on).
_fields.features.themeToggle: Dark/light toggle in the header. defaultTheme: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark'.
_fields.sections.*: true = page + home card + footer link render; false = section disappears everywhere.
